name: anastasya-store-core-agents
description: Core multi-agent configuration and governance framework for the repository.

agents.name: plan
agents.task: Execute design-tree grilling, ingest CONTEXT.md and the existing codebase, and output implementation_plan.md and PLAN.md for explicit user approval before any code changes start.

agents.name: build
agents.task: Implement narrow vertical slices at interface seams. Enforce strict Red-Green TDD (write a failing test first, implement minimum viable code, verify it passes).

agents.name: surgical
agents.task: Diagnose the root cause first, then apply the fix using the smallest possible diff.

agents.name: advisor
agents.access_restriction: Must NOT be selectable as a primary chat agent. Only invoked programmatically as a subagent via invoke_subagent.

agents.name: tester
agents.role: Automated test executor and regression verifier
agents.task: Execute automated test suites, type checks (tsc) and lint, analyze failure logs, verify test coverage at interface seams, and ensure regression safety.
agents.access_restriction: Subagent-only. Programmatically invoked by primary agents (build, surgical) or automated workflows.
